mapper.sql: o.id_ AS orderId, area.type_ AS areaType, area.name_ AS areaName, o.area_id, a.GRP_CODE AS grpCode, o.cust_name AS custName, b.SVC_NUM AS svcNum, b.WARNING_INFO AS warningInfo, b.EP_PURCHASE_SCHEME_NAME AS schemeName, b.NEW_SCHEME_NAME AS schemeName2, b.EP_PURCHASE_CREATE_DATE AS schemeCreateDate, b.NEW_CREATE_DATE AS xySchemeDate, b.EP_PURCHASE_EFF_DATE AS schemeEffDate, b.NEW_EFF_DATE AS xySchemeEffDate, b.EP_PURCHASE_EXP_DATE AS schemeExpDate, b.NEW_EXP_DATE AS xySchemeExpDate, o.order_number AS orderNumber, b.WRITEOFF_FEE AS writeOffFee, b.FEEDBACK_FLAG AS feedbackFlag, b.FEEDBACK_REMARK AS feedbackRemark, b.OPEN_DATE AS openDate, b.USER_STATUS AS userStatus, b.PROD_ID AS prodId, b.PROD_NAME AS prodName, b.DEVELOPER_ID AS developerId, b.DEVELOPER_NAME AS developerName, area.parent_ AS parentId, b.FEEDBACK_EXP_DATE AS feedbackExpDate, b.WARN_NEXT AS warnNext, b.RECTIFICATION_TIME AS rectificationTime, c.name_ch AS creatorName, c.relation_tel AS creatorPhone

o.id_ AS orderId, area.type_ AS areaType, area.name_ AS areaName, o.area_id, a.GRP_CODE AS grpCode, o.cust_name AS custName, b.SVC_NUM AS svcNum, b.scheme_name AS schemeName, DATE_FORMAT(b.eff_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS effTime, DATE_FORMAT(b.exp_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expTime, b.rate_ AS rate, b.amount_per_year AS amountPerYear, b.NEW_SCHEME_NAME AS schemeName2, DATE_FORMAT(b.NEW_CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newCreateTime, DATE_FORMAT(b.NEW_EFF_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS effTime2, DATE_FORMAT(b.NEW_EXP_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expTime2, b.NEW_SCHEME_PERIOD AS period, b.NEW_SCHEME_FEE AS amountPerYear2, b.user_addr AS userAddr, o.order_type AS orderType, o.order_number AS orderNumber, b.NEW_SCHEME_ID AS newSchemeId, b.RELATION_TYPE_NAME AS relationTypeName, b.exte_flag AS exteFlag, b.order_flow_no AS orderFlowNo, o.wide_result AS wideResult, area.parent_ AS parentId, c.name_ch AS creatorName, c.relation_tel AS creatorPhone

o.id_ AS orderId, area.type_ AS areaType, area.name_ AS areaName, o.area_id, a.GRP_CODE AS grpCode, o.cust_name AS custName, b.cloud_tag AS cloudTag, b.consume_type AS consumeType, DATE_FORMAT(b.consume_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS consumeTime, DATE_FORMAT(b.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endTime, b.server_duration AS serverDuration, b.amount_per_year AS amountPerYear, CASE WHEN b.new_consume_time IS NULL THEN '否' ELSE '是' END AS exeFlag, b.new_cloud_tag AS newCloudTag, b.new_consume_type AS newConsumeType, DATE_FORMAT(b.new_consume_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newConsumeTime, DATE_FORMAT(b.new_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newEndTime, b.new_server_duration AS newServerDuration, b.new_amount_per_year AS newAmountPerYear, o.order_number AS orderNumber, area.parent_ AS parentId, c.name_ch AS creatorName, c.relation_tel AS creatorPhone

o.id_ AS orderId, area.type_ AS areaType, area.name_ AS areaName, o.area_id, a.GRP_CODE AS grpCode, o.cust_name AS custName, b.SVC_NUM AS svcNum, b.LOCAL_CIRCUIT_CODE_A AS localCircuitCodeA, b.BUS_TYPE AS busType, b.INSTALL_COMPLE_TIME AS installCompleTime, b.AVG_RENTAL_CHARGES AS avgRentalCharges, b.CONTRACT_CODES AS contractCodes, b.CONTRACT_NAME AS contractName, CASE WHEN b.IS_RENT='1' THEN '是' WHEN b.IS_RENT='0' THEN '否' ELSE '' END AS isRent, b.START_RENT_TIME AS startRentTime, b.OPEN_DATE AS openDate, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.business_dep AS businessDep, c.name_ch AS creatorName, c.relation_tel AS creatorPhone, area.parent_ AS parentId

, (SELECT sc.name_ FROM sys_code sc WHERE sc.type_ = 'order_status' AND sc.code_ = o.status_) AS statusName, o.phase_name AS phaseName, o.actors_info AS actorsInfo, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime, (SELECT su1.name_ch FROM act_hi_taskinst his LEFT JOIN sys_user su1 ON su1.id_ = TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM his.ASSIGNEE_) WHERE his.PROC_INST_ID_ = o.pi_id ORDER BY his.START_TIME_ DESC LIMIT 1) AS assignee, (SELECT REPLACE(ahv.text_, 'null', '') FROM act_hi_taskinst his LEFT JOIN act_hi_varinst ahv ON ahv.task_id_ = his.id_ WHERE his.PROC_INST_ID_ = o.pi_id AND ahv.name_ = CONCAT(his.TASK_DEF_KEY_, '_resultMemo') ORDER BY his.START_TIME_ DESC LIMIT 1) AS result

FROM topp_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON o.creator_ = c.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON o.area_id = area.id_ LEFT JOIN maintenance_detail md ON o.id_ = md.order_id INNER JOIN ftp_tc_user_cust_warning a ON o.info_id = a.id_ INNER JOIN ftp_tc_user_common_warning b ON a.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = b.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO

FROM topp_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON o.creator_ = c.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON o.area_id = area.id_ INNER JOIN maintenance_detail md ON o.id_ = md.order_id INNER JOIN ftp_tc_user_cust_warning a ON o.info_id = a.id_ INNER JOIN wide_sys_auto_warning b ON a.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = b.main_order_flow_no

FROM topp_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON o.creator_ = c.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON o.area_id = area.id_ INNER JOIN maintenance_detail md ON o.id_ = md.order_id INNER JOIN ftp_tc_user_cust_warning a ON o.info_id = a.id_ INNER JOIN ftp_tc_grp_cloud_expire_alarm b ON a.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = b.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO

FROM topp_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON o.creator_ = c.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON o.area_id = area.id_ LEFT JOIN maintenance_detail md ON o.id_ = md.order_id INNER JOIN ftp_tc_leaseline_relet_cust_warning a ON o.info_id = a.id_ INNER JOIN ftp_tc_leaseline_relet_warning b ON a.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = b.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO

SELECT o.id_, o.area_id, o.cust_name, o.order_number, b.GRP_CODE, b.SVC_NUM, b.order_flow_no, o.wide_result, o.order_type, b.scheme_name, b.eff_time, b.exp_time, b.rate_, b.amount_per_year, b.NEW_SCHEME_NAME, b.NEW_CREATE_TIME, b.NEW_EFF_TIME, b.NEW_EXP_TIME, b.NEW_SCHEME_PERIOD, b.NEW_SCHEME_FEE, b.user_addr, o.status_, b.NEW_SCHEME_ID, b.RELATION_TYPE_NAME, b.exte_flag , md.business_dep , o.pi_id, o.phase_name, o.actors_info, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM topp_order o, ftp_tc_user_cust_warning a, wide_sys_auto_warning b, maintenance_detail md WHERE o.info_id = a.id_ AND o.order_category = 'C' AND a.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = b.main_order_flow_no AND o.id_ = md.order_id AND o.order_type = #{orderType}

SELECT o.id_, o.area_id, o.cust_name, o.order_number, b.GRP_CODE, b.SVC_NUM, b.order_flow_no, o.wide_result, o.order_type, b.scheme_name, b.eff_time, b.exp_time, b.rate_, b.amount_per_year, b.NEW_SCHEME_NAME, b.NEW_CREATE_TIME, b.NEW_EFF_TIME, b.NEW_EXP_TIME, b.NEW_SCHEME_PERIOD, b.NEW_SCHEME_FEE, b.user_addr, o.status_, b.NEW_SCHEME_ID, b.RELATION_TYPE_NAME, b.exte_flag , md.business_dep , o.pi_id, o.phase_name, o.actors_info, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM topp_order o, wide_sys_auto_warning b, maintenance_detail md WHERE o.info_id = b.id AND o.id_ = md.order_id AND o.order_category = 'U' AND o.order_type = #{orderType}

SELECT o.id_, o.area_id, o.cust_name, o.order_number, b.GRP_CODE, b.cloud_tag, b.consume_type, b.consume_time, b.end_time, b.server_duration, b.amount_per_year, b.new_cloud_tag, b.new_consume_type, b.new_consume_time, b.new_end_time, b.new_server_duration, b.new_amount_per_year, o.status_, o.pi_id, o.phase_name, o.actors_info, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM topp_order o, ftp_tc_user_cust_warning a, ftp_tc_grp_cloud_expire_alarm b, maintenance_detail md WHERE o.info_id = a.id_ AND o.order_category = 'C' AND a.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO = b.MAIN_ORDER_FLOW_NO AND o.id_ = md.order_id AND o.order_type = #{orderType}

SELECT o.id_, o.area_id, o.cust_name, o.order_number, b.GRP_CODE, b.cloud_tag, b.consume_type, b.consume_time, b.end_time, b.server_duration, b.amount_per_year, b.new_cloud_tag, b.new_consume_type, b.new_consume_time, b.new_end_time, b.new_server_duration, b.new_amount_per_year, o.status_, o.pi_id, o.phase_name, o.actors_info, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM topp_order o, ftp_tc_grp_cloud_expire_alarm b, maintenance_detail md WHERE o.info_id = b.id_ AND o.id_ = md.order_id AND o.order_category = 'U' AND o.order_type = #{orderType}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.opp_areas FROM sys_position p INNER JOIN sys_user_position up ON up.position_id = p.id_ WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.valid_ = 1 AND p.opp_areas IS NOT NULL AND p.opp_areas != ''
